$comment: ISOLATE-01 egress proxy, production (plan: ~/.claude/plans/isolate-01-compiler-egress.md, rollout step 1). The compiler classes and the proxy's fixed settings. A class is a subnet: a service's network.subnet names one, and the union of that class's services' network.allow lists is what it may reach. Until rollout step 3 the services' network blocks live in production/network.json, not deploy.json: a deploy.json block would put a compiler on the proxy at its next routine release. Classes: default (Graffiticode hosts only, most languages and the *r services), one per language with reviewed external hosts (l0000, l0176: www.googleapis.com for PREFLIGHT_GATEWAYS; l0013: storage.googleapis.com), and l0185 (open, D2). Images are step 0's pins (proved in graffiticode-isolate01, 2026-10-18).

open.$comment: D2: what L0185's open class may never name, refused by CONNECT authority (and Host, for plain http). Addresses are enforced by the network, not here.
